propositions: rebar must register a native Bedrock provider builder that constructs BedrockConverseModel without an OpenAI-compatible gateway, authenticating through AWS credential chain

prompt caching on Bedrock must set exactly two capability keys (bedrock_cache_instructions and bedrock_cache_tool_definitions) for parity with the direct-Anthropic path, excluding bedrock_cache_messages
rebar must warn when caching is requested but both cache_read_tokens and cache_write_tokens are zero despite positive input_tokens, since cache failure is silent and bills full input on every call

temperature parameter must be withdrawn from Bedrock models where it is unsupported (e.g. us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-7), implemented via a model-id-keyed capability override table distinct from f184's profile-shaped predicates

a 400 error matching the pattern (sampling parameter name + rejection word like 'deprecated') must be translated to LLMConfigError naming the model id and both remedies, rather than treated as generic LLMUnavailableError
the [bedrock] optional extra must be added to dev dependencies so unit tests run with mocked boto3 in CI, while keeping boto3 out of the default [agents] install
